firm_data.firm_description: Berger Fink LLP provides knowledgeable and practical solutions for business disputes and transactions. Their attorneys have a track record of creating specialized and workable solutions for a broad-based clientele.
notable_facts: The firm specializes in real estate and commercial disputes.
The firm also handles real estate transactions.

email.subject: AI for Berger Fink LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jason,

Since founding Berger Fink in 2018, you've built a practice handling real estate and commercial disputes that demands precision on every transaction and litigation matter. That specialization is exactly why we reach out.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by your Forest Hills office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on real estate and commercial work.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
